records.label: spacr.doctor#4
records.source: **A broken GUI dependency install.** PySide6 ships with the core package, but a missing or incomplete wheel can still make the ``spacr`` command fail on import. :mod:`spacr.qt` has a friendly path for that; :func:`check_qt_extra` reuses its logic so the two cannot drift.
records.context: **A broken GUI dependency install.** PySide6 ships with the core package, but a missing or incomplete wheel can still make the ``spacr`` command fail on import. :mod:`spacr.qt` has a friendly path for that; :func:`check_qt_extra` reuses its logic so the two cannot drift.
records.translation: **Uma instalação defeituosa das dependências da interface gráfica (GUI).** PySide6 vem com o pacote básico, mas um wheel ausente ou incompleto ainda pode fazer o comando ``spacr`` falhar na importação. :mod:`spacr.qt` oferece um diagnóstico claro para esse caso; :func:`check_qt_extra` reutiliza sua lógica para que ambas não divirjam.
records.review_basis: Direct Codex translation and technical review of the core GUI dependency contract and unchanged diagnostic key; all code and GUI literals retained.
